Test layout for [[Reflections Gold]]: Light Side then Dark Side, grouped by type (same shape as [[Dagobah Limited]]). Two picture columns: '''Original''' is the Category One playtest scan (Forum scan if C1 is empty); '''Enhanced''' is Andy Talaga's reconstruction. Landscape Enhanced/credit cards are rotated so the title reads across the top.

Where a Reflections Gold title matches a printed Decipher card of the same type, '''Type''', '''Destiny''', and '''Game text''' are copied from that original. Brand-new Reflections Gold cards that reuse a later title (for example the boy character [[Anakin Skywalker]] vs the Death Star II interrupt) keep their own type and are not filled from the other card. Combo cards take their type from the two halves (combos never mix types). '''Credits''' is the count of gold coin icons on the Enhanced reconstruction (not on the original print). The current article is [[Reflections Gold]].
